objective.title: Preserve chart derivative and pullback identities through the explicit-model scalar API
objective.statement: Compile the original20primary+companion chart identities after only17 applied extDerivFun substitutions to mvfderiv with the SAME existing I or I', three unfolding-name substitutions, and the proof-local h2 body of mpullbackWithin_extChartAt_symm_self. GenericK/E/H/M and all models, tangent/norm/derivative/pullback data, domains, field directions and original premises remain. Original/current generic scalar formulas pass by rfl; all normalized original kernel types/universe roles and standard-axiom/safety checks pass. Current primary formula and explicit-model literals elaborate. This supports retained full-root compatibility for proved smoothabilityS plus the independently verified upstream smooth-Poincare consumer; it constructs no independent original HamiltonH/convergence and claims no final acceptance. Dispatch base explicitly advanced to ff3ca4b6 after the disjoint Gaussian proof acceptance. Every protected definition/config hash and Chart source remain identical to prepared681e; original-source guard comparison is retained.
deliverables: Original public identities compile with the exact reviewed API normalization and h2 proof-only repair, or preserve fresh exact errors before any additional reviewed scope.
